full_judgment:
2. Prosecution case, in short, is that there has been a long standing enmity and protracted litigations between the informant Omar Ali on the one hand and accused party on the other. Messers Paul Choudhury was the Zaminder and Land holder of that locality and that they left the country and on their departure the property was made Khash by the Government as an abandoned property. The informant along with others took settlement of the land of Paul Choudhury. The accused party claiming them to be Borgadar of Paul Choudhury's land tried to dispossess them from the land and that led to the creation of much bad blood between them and got both parties involved in series of litigations. 

 13. PW 1 Omar Ali Sheikh lodged the First Information Report. Admittedly, he was not present at the time of commission of the murder nor he saw the appellants near about the place of occurrence. From his evidence it transpires that he along with many others took lease of the land of Paul Choudhury from the Government as those land was made Khas by the Government after the departure of Messers Paul Choudhury from this country. He further stated in his evidence that he suspected the appellants to be the murderer of his son Tapu because prior to this occurrence appellants threatened him with blood shed and for that he brought a case under section 107 CrPC Thus from his evidence it is proved that that much bad blood had been existing between the informant and the accused party over the property left by Messers Paul Choudhury.
